messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: P2 — sustained inference latency spike for hosted/text-generation in us-west-2. Error rate low but p95 tokens > 2s for several routes. Investigate and ack.

mike_oncall: acked. looking now. seeing elevated tail on g4-pool for model-redwood/open-13B-qlo. digging into swap/queue metrics.

eva_sre: FYI seeing increased batching queue depth ~x4, KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% around the same time. No deployments in the last hour. tagging @jamie_sec for visibility re: access or config churn.

mike_oncall: quick mitigation: lowering max_batch_size to 8 and forcing prioritized-routing to dedicated-backup. applying now.

ops-bot: Command run by mike_oncall: `/infra set-routing --pool g4-pool --policy prioritized-backup --max-batch 8` — started at 2024-07-31T18:05:12Z

mike_oncall: routing change applied. p95 down from ~2.6s -> ~1.1s in 3 min. continuing to monitor.

sarah_support: tickets starting to trickle in — 3 customers on hosted complaining about slower responses, none reporting failures. attaching example logs from customer-observability.

alex_prod: flagged on customer-impact board. we should prepare an external status note if SLA impacted. can someone confirm error budget burn? @mike_oncall

mike_oncall: error budget impact minimal (no request failures), but latency SLO breach risk for specific routes. recommending canary rollback of last config change that touched cache policy (rolled 2h ago) — that may be related.

eva_sre: I pulled the control-plane audit: there's no record of a cache-policy rollout in our audit logs for that time window. looks like a logging gap. pinging @jamie_sec — we need to capture evidence before we rotate logs.

jamie_sec: ack. that's concerning — if audit events are missing we need to collect ephemeral evidence now. please freeze any automated log rotations for the cluster and run `journalctl -u infra-agent --since "2 hours ago"` and pull /var/log/redwood-audit before it's overwritten.

mike_oncall: running commands now. output snippet:
```
2024-07-31T15:03:21Z service infra-agent: applied config: kv-cache:mode=adaptive
2024-07-31T15:03:22Z service infra-agent: rollout-id=cfg-79321
```
looks like there was a config change after all. full logs attached to thread.

jamie_sec: good catch. create an evidence bundle and upload to secure S3 (encrypted). tag with incident id `INC-20240731-1` and retain for 90 days. also need to open an internal ticket for audit-log reliability. assigning to me.

eva_sre: mitigation verification — p95 stable ~1.0s for last 12m after routing change + proactive cache warming on hot prefixes. will keep monitoring for 1h then handoff.

mike_oncall: leaving a runbook note: temporary reduce batch + prioritized-backup routing improved tail. aiming for full rollback of the adaptive cache change if root cause results indicate correlation. handing off to eva for next 3 hours. @eva_sre takes over on-call.

eva_sre: ack handoff. I'll monitor and coordinate with product/support on customer comms. scheduling post-incident review slot.

alex_prod: tentative postmortem availability poll: Thu 2024-08-01 14:00-15:00 PT or Fri 09:00-10:00 PT. prefer Thu. can we lock Thu? attendees: eng-runtime, eng-sre, sec, support, product.

sarah_support: Thu works. I'll prepare impacted customer list and sample logs for comms.

jamie_sec: Sec follow-up items:
- collect proof of audit log gap and timeline (done: evidence bundle `s3://secure-evidence/INC-20240731-1.zip`)
- review KMS access logs for infra-agent service account 72h window
- run integrity check on audit pipeline (checksum + sequence numbers) and report discrepancies
- recommend short-term hardening: disable auto-truncate on audit buffer until pipeline patch

mike_oncall: at 18:35Z all key routes recovered. marking incident as mitigated. will update incident status page.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20240731-1 state changed to MITIGATED by mike_oncall at 2024-07-31T18:35:44Z

alex_prod: scheduling postmortem: Thu 2024-08-01 14:00 PT — calendar invite sent to attendees. please add any pre-read notes to the doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-20240731-1

eva_sre: pre-reads I'm adding:
- timeline (raw metrics + console screenshots)
- short replay of config events
- suggested action items with owners

sarah_support: customer comm draft in doc, mark as 'ready for review' once we confirm no SLA violation requiring credit.

jamie_sec: security action items (create tickets):
1) AUD-3421 — investigate missing audit events and fix pipeline (owner: jamie_sec)
2) AUD-3422 — collect and verify KMS access logs + rotate service account creds if anomalies (owner: jamie_sec)
3) INF-5580 — add retention guard to audit buffer (owner: infra-team)
4) OPS-7789 — add endpoint-level latency alert to warn at 1.2s p95 (owner: eng-runtime)

eva_sre: noted owners. I'll add ETA estimates in the postmortem doc and link to task tracker.

mike_oncall: final note before sign-off: please flag any customers who received manual retries or escalations. support, plz share list in the doc.

sarah_support: uploaded list of affected customers and ticket IDs to the incident doc. none requested credits as of now.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Postmortem doc due in 24 hours. Reminder at 2024-08-01T12:00:00Z

jamie_sec: after initial forensics we did find a race in the audit forwarder where dropped events occurred during high-throughput sampling. patch queued.

eva_sre: follow-up verification steps (postmortem):
- reproduce load at scale in staging and confirm audit sampling doesn't drop events
- run chaos test on control plane to ensure rollouts always emit audit events
- add an end-to-end test in CI for audit pipeline sequence integrity

alex_prod: thanks everyone. closing the live page. we'll review action item progress in the postmortem and track to completion in the tracker. if anything else pops up ping here.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20240731-1 state changed to CLOSED by alex_prod at 2024-07-31T20:12:02Z

jamie_sec: postmortem summary will include: timeline, root cause hypothesis (audit-forwarder sampling race + adaptive cache rollout correlation), mitigation steps, and compliance impact assessment. expect draft in 24h.

eva_sre: will add measured improvements after the staging verification. leaving follow-up tasks assigned. thanks all for fast response :thumbsup:

sarah_support: closing customer-facing comm once sec confirms no evidence tampering. keeping customers updated as needed.

alex_prod: end of thread.
